terms.comment: The past before the past, “more than perfect”: lēgeram, I had read (Traupman 226). The term of the Latin grammars; we have not found it in Lewis & Short. In the pluperfect, tempore praeteritō plūsquamperfectō (Traupman 227).

sources: Lewis & Short: plus · Lewis & Short: perficio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 226, p. 227, p. 248.
